'''Saltlicker ribs''', sometimes called '''Cloned saltlicker [[Rib/Legends|ribs]]''', was a type of food offered in the galley of [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']]. It was enjoyed by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] alike.
